about: Measured Tc of materials outside Hurricane's training data, most of them found after the 2018 SuperCon snapshot that 3DSC is built on. They are only predicted, never used for training or for choosing a design. Each entry carries a reliability grade. Only replicated, ambient-pressure, bulk measurements in Hurricane's four families are scored; thin films, high pressure, metastable states, families outside its training data and single reports are shown but not scored, and refuted claims are listed only to record why they are left out. Lattice parameters are approximate literature values for the conventional cell and serve only as model inputs.

grades.single report: one group so far, possibly with several probes
grades.refuted: later work showed the effect has another origin

materials.name: UTe2
materials.note: found in 2019 at 1.6 K (ran2019); cleaner crystals reach 2.0 K

materials.name: CeRh2As2
materials.note: two superconducting phases in a magnetic field

materials.name: La3Ni2O7, bulk at ambient pressure
materials.note: not superconducting at ambient pressure; about 80 K above 14 GPa

materials.name: Nd0.8Sr0.2NiO2, bulk
materials.note: bulk samples do not superconduct, unlike thin films

materials.name: HgBa2Ca2Cu3O8+δ (Hg-1223)
materials.note: the ambient-pressure record since 1993; δ ≈ 0.25 assumed (near optimal doping); absent from the 3DSC training data

materials.name: Nd0.8Sr0.2NiO2, thin film
materials.note: films on SrTiO3 superconduct at 9 to 15 K; films are outside Hurricane's bulk training data

materials.name: Hg-1223 after a pressure quench
materials.note: a metastable state kept at ambient pressure after squeezing and a fast release; one group so far
